findings.question: Was future experimental reward environment generated internally by MB planner without experimenter constraints?
findings.source_adjudication: NO: fixed four-person outcome mappings, Gaussian drift, choices every ten and .75/.25 options experimentally imposed.

findings.question: Do observed animal rewards separately prove physical brain MF and MB substrate?
findings.source_adjudication: NO: model-agnostic repetition/generalization conditional behavior and simulation, no neural mechanism recorded.

findings.question: Could an MF-ignorant planner be non-indifferent outside the contrived symmetry?
findings.source_adjudication: YES: indifference applies precisely same-animal paired vegetable permutations with equal offered frequency; no general Bellman indifference.

findings.question: Are lazy encoder, MF-setting and reflective planner the same learned controller?
findings.source_adjudication: NO: original separate contributions and sub-model constraints. No novel meta-arbiter inferred.

findings.question: Are constant biases/bandit traces objectively identical to MF Q values?
findings.source_adjudication: NO: distinct control terms; signs permit novelty seeking, not only habit.

findings.question: Could generic direct MF reward-setting explain high/unrelated/low asymmetry?
findings.source_adjudication: Specified direct MF setting path boosts all animal reward categories; tested High>Unrelated>Low asymmetry requires reflective term in the fitted comparator set, not in every imagined policy.

findings.question: Is a High trial objectively guaranteed to have higher vegetable reward probability throughout following ten trials?
findings.source_adjudication: NO: exogenous independent drift can reverse, original labels refer previous setting.

findings.question: Does fitted rejection gamma=0 give direct identifiable physical introspective self-model proof?
findings.source_adjudication: NO: model comparisons reject a nested component only among included candidates, and author admits untested heuristics.

findings.question: Are 200 restarts and 2-wave fits equivalent to joint globally optimal likelihood under all parameter combinations?
findings.source_adjudication: NO: source explicitly simplified fit due expensive local minima; uncertainty in model selection beyond tested family.

findings.question: Does S5 model recovery prove independent raw data/model recovery verified by W3?
findings.source_adjudication: NO: published author simulations, original TIFF pixel integrity only; no independent full MATLAB/OSF replay.

findings.question: Do both MB and MF contribution correlations remain significant after parameter-tradeoff correction?
findings.source_adjudication: NO: MB association p=.06, MF p=.002 after bootstrap; RT rho=.5 supports convergence not direct latent data.

findings.question: Is P18 future planning mathematical mechanism identical to earlier 2019 retrospective credit assignment?
findings.source_adjudication: NO as formulated directions differ; both are same-author MB/MF lineage and independence is not established until direct ancestral comparison.

findings.question: Does a single agent-free scalar self-model learned through an extra coordinator occur explicitly?
findings.source_adjudication: NO: finite weighted source terms plus MF cached values, MB outcome values, traces, constant biases and task-imposed setting rule. Do not invent a new coordinator.

findings.question: Does complete original final article plus S5/S6 and S1 params mean subject task instruction PPTX exact audit?
findings.source_adjudication: NO: original PPTX not acquired and exact instruction-adherence excluded; source task conditions in final Fig2/Methods only.

findings.question: Does shared MB/MF nomenclature alone prove family overlap with PF04 or G2 INT15?
findings.source_adjudication: NO: compare future-setting operator vs PF04 option sequencing and G2 public genealogy under their own authority; both remain underdetermined.

findings.question: Does significance imply universal effect under every participant/task environment/price parameter?
findings.source_adjudication: NO: group original 30-person sample and conditional model-based tested contrasts, no all-subject generalization.
